agent_notes: No source found across web, news, video, social, image, book/archive or legal channels that names 'Tidasar/टिडासर' directly in a Bikaner/Lunkaransar/Mahajan context. All direct-spelling searches ('Tidasar Bikaner', 'टिडासर गांव बीकानेर', 'टिडासर महाजन लूणकरणसर', etc.) returned unrelated villages, generic district directories, or the project's own GitHub repo. The only village with a near-identical name that search engines surface is 'Tidiyasar' (टिडियासर/टिडासर), which Jatland and AccuWeather place in Ratangarh tehsil, CHURU district -- not Bikaner/Lunkaransar -- so it is likely a different, unrelated village and should not be merged with this unit without further verification. The Rajasthan District Gazetteer (Bikaner) full text on archive.org was checked directly and contains no mention of Tidasar/Tidiyasar. Patrika news coverage of the Mahajan Field Firing Range displacement (34 villages, 1984-85 acquisition) names several displaced villages by name across two articles but Tidasar is not among the ones explicitly listed in either. A September 2026 DVIDS article on Yudh Abhyas 2026 mentions a 'Chidasar Grand Stand' at Mahajan Field Firing Range -- phonetically close to Tidasar but spelled differently and unconfirmed as the same place; worth a human follow-up. Net: this village name currently rests only on the single Facebook comment-list source already known to the project; independent corroboration was not found within the 20-search budget.
